name: CityGaussian / VastGaussian / DoGaussian
definition: Divides the city into tiles, trains per tile, merges with overlap; uses LoD pyramid for streaming.
summary: CityGaussian, VastGaussian, and DoGaussian are block-based methods that enable scalable training and rendering of large urban scenes by partitioning environments into independent tiles, avoiding the memory limits of monolithic 3D Gaussian Splatting.
